en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing an elevated panoramic view over a riverside town with hills in the background. In the foreground, several steam-powered boats and barges move along a wide river with quays and railway tracks on the bank. On the right, a large baroque-style castle or palace complex with a tall tower sits on a wooded hill above the river. The town with dense historic buildings stretches into the valley behind. Red printed German text is visible at the top of the card.
